run.display_title: Government: native forensic adapters, pinned source audit and case transactions (#16)

head_commit.message:
Prove partition expiry before dispatch and after observed worker readiness

Retain the short-grant row and all authority/case/audit postconditions. Accept a refused expiry start only with a healthy journal, an actually expired request and zero launch/results/completed receipts. Add deterministic no-launch and live-worker-ready expiry cases. No production policy or timeout changes; preserve the original sanitizer failure and local LSan limitation.
